ae_item_base_info_dto.subject: 100Pcs Natural Wooden Golf Tees, Mixed Color Bulk Tees for Driving Range, Eco-Friendly Resealable Bag
ae_item_base_info_dto.detail:
Key Features:


High-Quality Material: Made from durable, eco-friendly wood for long-lasting performance.


Mixed Colors: 100 pieces in random colors for easy identification and a fun, vibrant look.


Stable & Consistent: Ensures a steady ball position for improved accuracy and distance.


Versatile Use: Suitable for all types of golfers, from beginners to professionals.


Eco-Friendly: Environmentally conscious choice for sustainable golfing.



Package Includes:


100 x Wooden Golf Tees (Random Colors)
